Name: Xtardew Female
Author: hixega
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y78D9Qz8/description.png[/img]

This mod patches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url] to include dialogue for both female and male farmers.

Farmer gender is checked during patching, only changing dialogue for females.

Now updated for Stardew Valley 1.6!

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/8nC7LX4n/installation.png[/img]
[/b]
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Install the parts of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url] you want to use.
3. Install the matching parts from Xtardew Female.
4. Run the game using SMAPI, and enjoy!

Alternatively, for Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition:

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Install Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition.
3. Install Xtardew Female - Sexperimental Edition.
4. Run the game using SMAPI, and enjoy!

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/zMDpWRM/compatibility.png[/img]
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url]: Fully compatible, each module depends on the original counterpart.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15787]Anime HD Xtardew Portraits[/url]: Great Xtardew portraits, highly recommended!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37617]Xtardew - Milfs And Poly And More[/url]: Patched when installed alongside our main mod file.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10532]
Valley Girls[/url]: Great companion mod, fully compatible and highly recommended!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url]: 90% compatible, remove the wizard content if you have Rasmodia.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9598]Succu Queen[/url]: Dialogue patched for Abigail's events, replacing "Prairie King".
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5029?tab=description]Nude Farmer and Swimsuits[/url]: Fantastic mod to include farmer nudity.

[size=4][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/TB6Fp82p/community.png[/img]
[/b][/size]
Want to chat? You can find me in the [url=http://discord.gg/3Z7A5xHWTn]StarLewd Valley[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/cAPJ5MevF5]Xtardew Valley[/url]﻿ discord servers :D

Please consider supporting me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/hixega]Patreon[/url] <3

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/zT4Y7Vcv/future-plans.png[/img]
[/b]
Adding new animations for females. Currently, they use the existing male animations, which aren't perfect.

Maybe a bachelor companion mod, adding dialogue and animations for female farmers with male characters.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/7tnBcTvm/bugs-and-suggestions.png[/img]
[/b]
Please report bugs and suggestions here on the Nexus page, I'll work on them when I can ^^

Anyone is welcome to work on translations <3
